passiveEffects.name: Static
passiveEffects.originalDescription: Paralyzes all enemies nearby for a short time when receiving damage. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered. When damaged, paralyzes nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this Ability is decreased by 30% for 2.5s and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s.

moveEffects.name: Thunder Shock
moveEffects.originalDescription: Release electricity, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also paralyzes enemies for a short time. Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them when it hits. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Thunderstorm
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Attacks enemies near the user with tremendous bolts of lightning. Becomes unstoppable and jumps into the air, then casts down bolts of lightning 4 times over 3s in a radius around Pikachu. The first cast targets all Pokémon on the opposing team in range with 1 bolt each; these bolts damage up to 1 target each. The following 3 casts target up to 2 random Pokémon from the opposing team in range; these following bolts deal damage to opposing Pokémon in a small area around them, but targets can only be damaged once for each of the following 3 casts. Pikachu can act freely once the first bolts of lightning are cast down. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield
